en.title: Longest Non-Decreasing Run
en.description:
Output the length of the longest contiguous non-decreasing subarray of an integer array. Each element may equal the previous one.

The standard input/output, examples, and tests are written by CSWork; ranges marked "this site" are judging conventions and are not claimed to be original interview limits.
en.input: The first line contains n (1..100000); the second line contains n integers (−10⁹..10⁹).
en.output: Output the answer as described; results for multiple queries are separated by spaces, in order.
en.explanation: Example 1: the run 2, 4, 6, 8 is the longest, with length 4. Example 2: equal values are allowed, so the three 5s form a run of length 3. Example 3: every step decreases, so only a single element can be taken.
hints: Maintain the length of the non-decreasing run ending at the current element; reset it to 1 on a decrease, otherwise increment it.
